video.presenter_prompt: A kind Northern Nigerian female community health worker in a light blue uniform and headscarf, speaking warmly to the camera in a clean, bright primary health care clinic
video.script_en: A child's first one thousand days shape their whole life. For the first six months, give your baby only breast milk, not even water. From six months, add soft family foods: grains, beans, eggs, vegetables and fruit. If your child is losing weight, or their arms are getting thin, take them to the clinic early. Treatment is available. Strong children start with us.
